steps.name: delete-merged-or-abandoned-working-refs-except-current-fix
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1
EXPECTED_MAIN=4f5c261301b865ea4af1bbb8d274c7dbd469d707
ACTUAL_MAIN="$(gh api repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/branches/main --jq '.commit.sha')"
if [[ "$ACTUAL_MAIN" != "$EXPECTED_MAIN" ]]; then echo "MAIN_CHANGED_STOP=true"; exit 40; fi
CURRENT_FIX="fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123"
mapfile -t BRANCHES < <(gh api --paginate repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/branches --jq '.[].name' | sort -u)
printf 'BRANCH_COUNT_BEFORE=%s\n' "${#BRANCHES[@]}"
printf '%s\n' "${BRANCHES[@]}" | grep -qx 'main'
printf '%s\n' "${BRANCHES[@]}" | grep -qx 'agent-control'
printf '%s\n' "${BRANCHES[@]}" | grep -qx "$CURRENT_FIX"
OPEN="$(gh pr list -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --state open --json number --jq 'length')"
test "$OPEN" = 0 || { echo "OPEN_PRS_REFUSE_DELETE=true"; exit 41; }
COUNT=0
for b in "${BRANCHES[@]}"; do
  case "$b" in main|agent-control|fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123) continue;; esac
  echo "DELETING_WORK_BRANCH=$b"
  gh api -X DELETE "repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/git/refs/heads/$b" >/dev/null
  COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
done
echo "OLD_WORK_BRANCHES_DELETED=$COUNT"
mapfile -t REMAIN < <(gh api --paginate repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/branches --jq '.[].name' | sort -u)
printf 'REMAINING_BRANCHES=%s\n' "${REMAIN[*]}"
test "${#REMAIN[@]}" -eq 3
printf '%s\n' "${REMAIN[@]}" | grep -qx 'main'
printf '%s\n' "${REMAIN[@]}" | grep -qx 'agent-control'
printf '%s\n' "${REMAIN[@]}" | grep -qx "$CURRENT_FIX"
echo "OLD_BRANCH_CLEANUP_PASS=true"
